svg.aria-label: pipekit-cycle on the GeoStack role ladder: the eight cycles as recipes, the observation operators and forward models as steps, no algorithm of its own (the analysis is filterax's and vardax's), the protocols as the contracts a model satisfies, the adjoint specs as strategies, no primitives, and the carry states as structures; pipekit-ops's StatefulOperator and CarryState, and the integrix and argminax functions that read the specs, sit beside the ladder.
svg.title: pipekit-cycle on the role ladder
